scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for Assistance to Mega Industries: Reimbursement of SGST Paid on Capital Goods
other_conditions: Minimum investment of ₹2,500 crore in plant and machinery
Direct employment of at least 2,500 persons
Unit must belong to one of the thrust sectors as defined in the Guidelines
Capital goods must be acquired within the investment period specified under the scheme
Unit must commence commercial production within the timeline set by the scheme
benefits_summary: Full reimbursement of SGST paid on capital goods for eligible mega manufacturing units, paid in 20 equal annual installments.
